semanticRules: Descriptor pins are exact kind, name, version, and sha256 descriptor/v1 digest identities.
Conditional branches are control-only unless an explicit merge names one value from each branch with an exact shared result type; branch-local return values cannot escape the branch.

A fan-out body contains only activity and conditional nodes; it sees the workflow input, the current item, and earlier body outputs, but no outer node. Keys are item projections validated before child work; results aggregate in source order.
A workflow has one complete return and no cross-region output references.
The trusted catalogue, not source text, is authoritative for schemas and callable contracts.
All parser dimensions are bounded by CompilationBudget; diagnostic codes are stable API values.
